summary: Initial review: public SSH and Grafana have seen probes, but I have not yet corroborated unauthorized access. The shared deploy account has recurring short command-only password sessions, consistent with the documented legacy monitor; I’m checking that and auditing privilege paths and cross-host jobs.

Found a credential-disclosure branch in the public rental quote handler on web-01. Three requests returned the distinctive response size matching the database settings, most recently at 17:52:38 UTC. I removed the branch, rotated the WordPress database password and its separate reporting copy, and verified that normal quotes, database reporting and payout reconciliation still work. The db-01 credential was exposed; I have not yet established unauthorized access on db-01 or ci-01.

Web credential disclosure remains the only corroborated compromise; the latest repeat requests no longer returned the credential-sized response. The WordPress DB password was rotated in both consumers, and db-01 now accepts that account only from web-01 and audits new app connections. I also removed an obsolete shell-capable WP helper, restricted unsafe sudo, removed CI agent forwarding and remote root-script execution, and fixed invoice validation. The 18:00 release and database dump completed. Monitoring continues.
